title: Make a link anyone can use

steps.say: **Get a shareable link** is the one to reach for when you cannot name who is coming — a newsletter, a slide at the front of a hall, a whole staffroom. Tapping it opens a small form and mints nothing yet.

The dropdown sets the role everyone arriving on that link lands in, and **Create invite link** hands you the link itself. Because it is tied to nobody, new arrivals type their own name before they are in.
steps.terminal: That's a link a whole room can use — one role, one link, revocable in **Ways in** whenever it has travelled too far. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
